CreateFlowAlias.title: CreateFlowAlias
CreateFlowAlias.summary: Creates an alias for a flow. You can then use the alias to start an execution.

DescribeExecution.title: DescribeExecution
DescribeExecution.summary: Queries the status of an execution. This operation supports long polling. The WaitTimeSeconds parameter specifies the maximum wait time.

DescribeFlowAlias.title: DescribeFlowAlias
DescribeFlowAlias.summary: Queries the details of a flow alias.

DescribeMapRun.title: DescribeMapRun
DescribeMapRun.summary: Retrieves the details of a MapRun.

DescribeRegions.title: Query region information
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the regions supported by CloudFlow.

DescribeSchedule.title: DescribeSchedule
DescribeSchedule.summary: Queries the detailed information about a time-based schedule.

GetExecutionHistory.title: GetExecutionHistory
GetExecutionHistory.summary: Queries the details about each step in an execution process.

ListExecutions.title: ListExecutions
ListExecutions.summary: Lists the execution history of a flow.

ListFlowAliases.title: ListFlowAliases
ListFlowAliases.summary: Lists the aliases for a flow.

ListFlowVersions.title: ListFlowVersions
ListFlowVersions.summary: Lists the versions of a flow.

ListSchedules.title: ListSchedules
ListSchedules.summary: Queries time-based schedules in a flow.

PublishFlowVersion.title: PublishFlowVersion
PublishFlowVersion.summary: Publishes a new version of a flow based on its current definition. A flow version includes the flow's definition, description, environment variable settings, and execution role. The version number starts at 1 and increments with each new version.

StopExecution.title: StopExecution
StopExecution.summary: Stops an execution that is in progress in a flow.

UpdateFlow.title: UpdateFlow
UpdateFlow.summary: Updates the content of a flow.

UpdateFlowAlias.title: UpdateFlowAlias
UpdateFlowAlias.summary: Updates the alias configuration for a flow.

UpdateMapRun.title: UpdateMapRun
UpdateMapRun.summary: Updates the configuration of a MapRun.
